algorithm: sha256tree/1 — sha256 over the sorted lines '<file sha256><two spaces><dataset-relative path>' for every regular file under the listed task directories; one digest per set

catalogue_identity_fnv.verbatim_from: the frozen manifest's manifest.suite.catalogue_identity — a 64-bit FNV-1a over sorted task ids mislabelled 'sha256:'; retained as the identity of record, never replaced by these digests

catalogue80.task_list: every directory of the local dataset copy

task_content: never committed — the dataset carries a training-corpus canary (e.g. swe-bench-langcodes/run-tests.sh)
recompute: python3 -I docs/build/tools/p1_records.py --check --dataset <dir> — RC-2 recomputes both digests when a dataset tree is supplied; with none it reports skipped(dataset_absent), never a pass
note: tb's run_metadata.json records dataset_name: null and commit_hash: unknown — these content digests are the only dataset identity
